title: Preserving a segment under agreement
statement: Let $\mu,\mu':\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $l$ be a finite list of integers whose entries are the values of $\mu$ starting at $a$. If $\mu'$ agrees with $\mu$ at every index $j$ satisfying $a\le j<a+|l|$, then the entries of $l$ are also the values of $\mu'$ starting at $a$.
hypotheses_covered: The values of $\mu$ starting at $a$ equal the entries of $l$
Agreement of $\mu'$ and $\mu$ for every $j$ with $a\le j<a+|l|$
